instructions:
Write an essay in response to the assignment below. Aim for about 340 words. The file must contain only the essay itself: no notes, no commentary, no word count.

Assignment: Your principal is considering changing school policy so that students may not participate in sports or other activities unless they have at least a grade B average. Many students have a grade C average. 
She would like to hear the students' views on this possible policy change. Write a letter to your principal arguing for or against requiring at least a grade B average to participate in sports or other activities. Be sure to support your arguments with specific reasons.
